scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix backend
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix && npm --prefix backend run lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix backend run test
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.db:lint: supabase db lint --local --schema public --level warning --fail-on error
